# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 10 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** The Blessing of Discipline

---

**10:1** Blessed is the man the LORD calls to mind with a rebuke —
whom he holds back from the road to ruin with a lash —

**10:2** to scrub him clean of sin before it multiplies,
so that the LORD may keep his soul from the final blow;

**10:3** he heals the righteous man who receives discipline humbly
and restores his soul to a lifelong fear of God.

**10:4** But the sinner who trips through all his days,
who chooses evil deliberately — he is abandoned to it;

**10:5** the LORD steps back and lets him do as he will,
for his way on this earth is evil through and through.

**10:6** God has no desire to see a transgressor thrive;
he arranges disaster for him, fitted exactly to the evil he has done.

**10:7** The man who lives this way is like one God has forsaken;
but the righteous man is the LORD's own treasure.

**10:8** So, O LORD — the one you love will not be allowed to fall;
you discipline him, so that he will return to you.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering prioritizing poetic force and contemporary resonance. Sense-for-sense.*
